title.zh: DDoS防御先驱再创业：a16z领投3800万美元，做AI Agent版Tailscale
title.en: DDoS防御先驱再创业：a16z领投3800万美元，做AI Agent版Tailscale

current_state.zh: Prolexic founder Barrett Lyon launched doxx.net, an 'agent-era Tailscale' that puts long-running AI agents on a private network with per-agent permissions and lets agents reconfigure their own network access, raising a $38M Series A led by a16z.
